	# House 16800196: Soundavara-Lyubim -> Soundavara-Obnore (via spouse of c_scalovia holder)
	# House 33569509: Soundavara-Molina -> Soundavara-Erkawîka (via same dynasty, male house head)
	# House 23369: Sheksna-Kholmogory -> Sheksna-Dwina (via spouse of Soundavara-Obnore house head)
	title:c_scalovia.holder.primary_spouse ?= {
		if = {
			limit = { exists = house }
			house = {
				set_house_name = tarr_house_soundavara_obnore
				house_head.primary_spouse ?= {
					if = {
						limit = { exists = house }
						house = { set_house_name = tarr_house_sheksna_dwina }
					}
				}
			}
			dynasty ?= {
				every_dynasty_house = {
					limit = {
						exists = house_head
						house_head = { is_female = no }
					}
					set_house_name = tarr_house_soundavara_erkawika
				}
			}
		}
	}
